approval_rubric.policy: The simulated operator approves a draft unless it violates one of these written rules. A violating draft is rejected with the rule code(s) as the reason. The operator never edits a draft.

rules.R1_quantity: A stated number of pictures, videos or items must equal the product contents (2 pictures, 1 video, 3 items in all), and no quantity may be stated before any card was ever sent to this fan.
rules.R2_price: Any stated money amount must be exactly the fixed price (6.00 USD). A card must carry exactly 600 cents in USD. No discount, cheaper option, bundle or payment plan.
rules.R3_false_claim: No statement that he bought, unlocked, paid for or owns the set unless a verified purchase exists; no statement that she already sent something that this draft does not carry.
rules.R4_boundary: No agreement or hint to meet, move to another app or number, make a custom, or anything involving a minor.
rules.R5_identity: No claim to be human, real or 'not an agency', and no statement about who reads, writes or approves the chats (no identity wording is approved).
rules.R6_commercial_state: No card while selling is paused, after the set was bought, or while an earlier card is still unanswered and unbought.
rules.R7_withholding: No answer or item may be made conditional on him answering, telling her something or earning it.
rules.R8_hygiene: No em or en dashes, no more than 4 parts, no more than 5 emojis.
rules.R9_repeated_question: No question she already asked in her last 4 delivered messages, even if he skipped it.
rules.R10_timed_followup: No promise of a timed follow-up message or of talking again at a set time.
